source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Preserve the formal opening and fulfillment language rather than reduce the events to reported facts.
verses.before: Since many have undertaken to put together an account of the events that have been fulfilled among us,
verses.after: Since many have undertaken to put together an account of the events fulfilled among us,
verses.tsw_comparator: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative about the matters that have been fulfilled among us,

verses.rationale: Keep both roles of the transmitters and the word as the object of their service.
verses.before: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word,
verses.after: drawing on what was handed down to us by those who were eyewitnesses from the beginning and became servants of the word.
verses.tsw_comparator: just as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word handed them down to us,

verses.rationale: Make the author's investigation and decision clear while retaining the formal address and orderly claim.
verses.before: I too decided, after carefully investigating everything from the beginning, to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.after: I too decided, after carefully investigating everything from the beginning, to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.tsw_comparator: it seemed good to me also—having followed all things closely from the start—to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.rationale: Retain the stated purpose of assurance without supplying an unstated social identity for the recipient.
verses.before: so that you may know the reliability of the things you have been taught.
verses.after: so that you may know how reliable the things you have been taught are.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that you may know the certainty of the things about which you have been instructed.

verses.rationale: Keep the reign, priestly division, and both family connections in two readable sentences.
verses.before: In the days of King Herod of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah from the division of Abijah. His wife was a descendant of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.after: In the days when Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah from the division of Abijah. His wife, Elizabeth, was also descended from Aaron.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the days of King Herod of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah; and he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

verses.rationale: Preserve the narrator's positive assessment and both kinds of divine instruction.
verses.before: Both of them were righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the Lord’s commandments and requirements.
verses.after: Both were righteous before God, living blamelessly according to all the Lord's commandments and requirements.
verses.tsw_comparator: Both of them were righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and statutes of the Lord.

verses.rationale: Retain the narrator's explanation and their shared age without turning childlessness into a moral judgment.
verses.before: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was unable to have children, and both of them were advanced in years.
verses.after: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was unable to conceive, and both were advanced in years.
verses.tsw_comparator: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and both were advanced in years.

verses.rationale: Make the priest the explicit subject while allowing the lot-selection sentence to continue.
verses.before: One day, while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
verses.after: Once, when Zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now while Zechariah was serving as priest before God when his division was on duty,

verses.rationale: Keep the selection method, customary practice, and specific sanctuary task.
verses.before: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the Lord’s sanctuary and burn incense.
verses.after: he was chosen by lot, according to priestly custom, to enter the Lord's sanctuary and burn incense.
verses.tsw_comparator: according to the custom of the priesthood, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

verses.rationale: Retain the parallel action outside and the ritual time marker.
verses.before: The whole assembly of the people was praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.after: At the hour of incense, the whole gathering of people was outside praying.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

verses.rationale: Keep the visible messenger and exact position without importing the messenger's name before its disclosure.
verses.before: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.after: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the incense altar.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.rationale: Preserve the twofold reaction in natural English rather than soften fear into curiosity.

verses.after: Zechariah was shaken at the sight, and fear came over him.
verses.tsw_comparator: And Zechariah was troubled when he saw the angel, and fear fell upon him.

verses.after: The angel said, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah. Your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to name him John.

verses.tsw_comparator: He will turn many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.

verses.after: Zechariah asked the angel, “How can I be sure of this? I am an old man, and my wife is advanced in years.”

verses.rationale: Retain self-identification, divine presence, and the sending passive without conflating the messenger and sender.

verses.after: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel. I stand in God's presence, and I was sent to speak to you and bring you this good news.

verses.after: But now you will be silent, unable to speak until the day these things happen, because you did not believe my words. They will be fulfilled at their appointed time.”

verses.rationale: Clarify the simultaneous outside scene and the reason for the people's wonder.
verses.before: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he was taking so long in the sanctuary.
verses.after: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he stayed so long in the sanctuary.

verses.rationale: Resolve repeated pronouns and preserve their inference and his continued gestures without diagnosing deafness.

verses.after: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized that he had seen a vision in the sanctuary. He kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

verses.rationale: Express the completed days of duty naturally without specifying a duration absent here.

verses.after: When his period of service ended, he went home.
verses.tsw_comparator: And when his days of service were ended, he went to his home.

verses.rationale: Keep conception, deliberate seclusion, and the exact period without inventing a motive.

verses.after: Afterward his wife Elizabeth conceived. She kept herself out of sight for five months, saying,

verses.after: “This is what the Lord has done for me. He has looked on me with favor and taken away my disgrace among people.”

verses.after: She was deeply troubled by his words and wondered what kind of greeting this could be.

verses.rationale: Retain the relative without specifying cousin and the sixth-month confirmation.

verses.before: In the synagogue was a man who had the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out loudly,
verses.after: In the synagogue was a man with the spirit of an unclean demon. He shouted loudly,
verses.tsw_comparator: And in the synagogue there was a man having a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,

verses.rationale: Retain the plural us shifting to singular I, the challenge, and the identifying title.
verses.before: “Ah! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”
verses.after: “Ah! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: God's Holy One!”
verses.tsw_comparator: “Ha! What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God.”

verses.rationale: Resolve the target of rebuke and the affected man while retaining no harm after the violent movement.
verses.before: Jesus rebuked him: “Be silent and come out of him!” The demon threw the man down in front of them and came out without harming him.
verses.after: Jesus rebuked the demon: “Be silent and come out of him!” The demon threw the man down in front of them and came out without harming him.
verses.tsw_comparator: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him.” And the demon, throwing him down in the midst, came out from him without harming him.

verses.rationale: Keep the question about the word and distinguish authority from power without inserting an interpretation.
verses.before: Amazement came over everyone, and they said to one another, “What kind of word is this? With authority and power he commands unclean spirits, and they come out!”
verses.after: Everyone was amazed. They said to one another, “What is this word? He commands unclean spirits with authority and power, and they come out!”
verses.tsw_comparator: And astonishment came upon all, and they were speaking with one another, saying, “What is this word, that with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out?”

verses.rationale: Preserve the widening report as the scene's conclusion.
verses.before: News about him spread into every place in the surrounding region.
verses.after: Reports about him spread to every place in the surrounding region.
verses.tsw_comparator: And a report about him was going out into every place of the surrounding region.

verses.rationale: Keep kinship, severity, and intercession while clarifying the request's purpose.
verses.before: Jesus left the synagogue and entered Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they appealed to him for her.
verses.after: Jesus left the synagogue and entered Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then he arose from the synagogue and entered Simon’s house. Now Simon’s mother-in-law was suffering with a high fever, and they appealed to him concerning her.

verses.rationale: Retain fever as the object rebuked and immediate service without calling the illness demonic.
verses.before: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she got up and began serving them.
verses.after: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she got up and began serving them.
verses.tsw_comparator: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she arose and began serving them.

verses.rationale: Preserve sunset, the range of illnesses, and individualized touch rather than collapse into a mass healing.
verses.before: When the sun was setting, everyone who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him. He laid his hands on each of them and healed them.
verses.after: As the sun was setting, everyone who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him. He laid his hands on each one and healed them.
verses.tsw_comparator: When the sun was setting, all who had people sick with various diseases brought them to him. Laying his hands on each one of them, he healed them.

verses.rationale: Retain both titles and the narrator's stated reason for silencing.
verses.before: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are God’s Son!” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Christ.
verses.after: Demons also came out of many, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But he rebuked them and would not let them speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.
verses.tsw_comparator: Demons also came out from many, crying out and saying, “You are the Son of God!” But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

verses.rationale: Keep the daybreak withdrawal and the crowds' attempted restraint without adding prayer from another account.
verses.before: When day came, he went out to a deserted place. The crowds searched for him, came to him, and tried to keep him from leaving them.
verses.after: At daybreak Jesus went out to a deserted place. The crowds searched for him, found him, and tried to keep him from leaving them.
verses.tsw_comparator: When day came, he went out and departed to a desolate place. The crowds were seeking him, and they came to him and tried to keep him from going away from them.

verses.rationale: Preserve necessity, wider mission, kingdom, and the sending passive.
verses.before: But he said, “I must announce the good news of God’s kingdom to the other towns also, because this is why I was sent.”
verses.after: But he told them, “I must bring the good news of God's kingdom to the other towns too, because that is why I was sent.”
verses.tsw_comparator: But he said to them, “I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other cities also, because for this I was sent.”

verses.rationale: Follow the pinned Judea reading rather than harmonize the region to Galilee.
verses.before: And he continued proclaiming in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.after: He continued proclaiming the message in the synagogues of Judea.
verses.tsw_comparator: And he was proclaiming in the synagogues of Judea.
